title: Per Diem Shortfall Day Count Decision Table (Closing and Funding)
content:
For a Closing and Funding per diem shortfall, the charge collected at closing is the closing's prepaid interest charge booked on the signing date, and a late-funding refund is a prepaid interest refund entry marked as a refund for funding later than estimated.

**Rule.** The shortfall days are counted as follows: where a late-funding refund names the charge collected at closing, they are every day of that charge less every day those refunds return; where no such refund stands and the disbursement date falls on or after the first day and on or before the last day of that charge, they are the days from the disbursement date through the last day of the charge, both counted; otherwise they are every day of the charge.

| A late-funding refund names the charge? | Disbursement date within the charge? | Shortfall days |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | either | every day of the charge less every day those refunds return |
| No | Yes | disbursement date through the charge's last day, both counted |
| No | No | every day of the charge |

## Cases (hypothetical; charge collected at closing covers the 24th through the 30th, 7 days)

| Situation | Shortfall days |
|---|---|
| late-funding refunds naming the charge return 3 days in total | 7 less 3: 4 |
| no such refund; disbursement date the 27th | the 27th through the 30th: 4 |
| no such refund; disbursement date the 24th | the 24th through the 30th: 7 |
| no such refund; disbursement date the 2nd of the next month | every day of the charge: 7 |
